answer: Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield attached to Highland Giant and triggers twice. (611.3c) The first trigger will return Highland Giant to the battlefield. The second trigger just does the same things again, so it has no relevant result.
board_state: Referenced cards: Panharmonicon; Mycosynth Lattice; Highland Giant; Traveling Philosopher; Dance of the Dead

cited_rules.611.3c: Continuous effects that modify characteristics of permanents do so simultaneously with the permanent entering the battlefield. They don't wait until the permanent is on the battlefield and then change it. Because such effects apply as the permanent enters the battlefield, they are applied before determining whether the permanent will cause an ability to trigger when it enters the battlefield.
